stories.title: Christa Pike sigue con vida tras recibir dos inyecciones letales en Tennessee

en.title: Christa Pike remains alive after receiving two lethal injections in Tennessee
en.summary: A woman survived two lethal injections in Tennessee after the state Supreme Court authorized her execution, though an appeals court had briefly halted the procedure. She was transferred to a hospital for life-saving measures.

stories.title: Los tres días previos a la entrada masiva en Ceuta, según el relato de Vivas ante la jueza

en.title: The three days before the mass entry into Ceuta, according to Vivas's account before the judge
en.summary: The president of Ceuta testified that he personally alerted three ministers and the chief of staff to a government crisis before a mass migration event on July 30. He will provide phone records to the court.

stories.title: Pánico a bordo del vuelo FZ1073 con destino a Tel Aviv: “Acabamos de neutralizar al terrorista. Necesitamos ayuda”

en.title: Panic aboard flight FZ1073 bound for Tel Aviv: "We just neutralized the terrorist. We need help"
en.summary: A pilot stabbed another pilot during a flight to Tel Aviv, but passengers prevented a disaster. Israel plans to intensify security checks for pilots flying to the country following the incident.

stories.title: Cronología visual del intento de secuestro del vuelo de FlyDubai con destino a Tel Aviv

en.title: Visual timeline of the attempted hijacking of the FlyDubai flight bound for Tel Aviv
en.summary: A video reconstruction chronicles the tense moments experienced by passengers from the initial turbulence through the aircraft's landing in Israel.

stories.title: Israel enmarca el atentado aéreo como un ataque «contra los acuerdos de Abraham»

en.title: Israel frames air attack as assault "against the Abraham Accords"
en.summary: Israel's Foreign Ministry informed diplomats that an incident on a UAE flight to Tel Aviv, which required emergency landing, was a terrorist attack intended to undermine relations between the allied nations.

stories.title: Autorizan la ejecución de Christa Pike, la primera mujer condenada a muerte en Tennessee

en.title: Execution of Christa Pike, first woman sentenced to death in Tennessee, authorized
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court lifted a temporary stay and permitted the execution of Christa Pike, the only woman on death row in Tennessee, convicted of first-degree murder in 1996 when she was 19 years old.

stories.title: El primer cargo del PSOE caído por Ceuta, ante la juez tras detallar Vivas 10 llamadas con Moncloa

en.title: First PSOE official fallen over Ceuta appears before judge after Vivas details 10 calls with Moncloa
en.summary: Gonzalo Sanz, former chief of staff to the government delegate in Ceuta, testified before the National Court regarding warnings he received from intelligence services and how he communicated them.

stories.title: La rabieta más grande de Cristiano: abandona la concentración de Portugal

en.title: Cristiano's biggest tantrum: leaves Portugal concentration
en.summary: Portuguese striker Cristiano Ronaldo abandoned Portugal's team concentration in Copenhagen hours before a match against Denmark, following through on earlier statements about leaving if the coach did not count on him.

stories.title: Rusia convulsiona Europa con su amenaza de usar armas nucleares contra la OTAN: "Quiere intimidar a la opinión pública de los países aliados"

en.title: Russia convulses Europe with threat of nuclear weapons against NATO: "Wants to intimidate public opinion of allied countries"
en.summary: Russia warned through official communication that it is prepared to use its full military arsenal if allied countries attempt to isolate Kaliningrad, a warning NATO acknowledges but calls for calm.

stories.title: Israel investiga como ataque terrorista el incidente del vuelo de Flydubai: "Uno de los pilotos apuñaló al otro. Al parecer, intentó estrellar el avión con sus ocupantes"

en.title: Israel investigates Flydubai flight incident as terrorist attack: "One of the pilots stabbed the other. Apparently he tried to crash the plane with its occupants"
en.summary: Israel is investigating a Flydubai flight incident as a terrorist attack after one pilot stabbed another. The injured Indian pilot is hospitalized in stable condition in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Execution of Christa Pike halted at the last minute by a Tennessee appeals court

en.title: Execution of Christa Pike halted at the last minute by a Tennessee appeals court
en.summary: A Tennessee appeals court stopped the execution of Christa Pike, who was 18 when she killed a fellow student in 1995. Her defense team has requested that her death sentence be commuted to life imprisonment.

stories.title: El piloto de un vuelo de Dubái con destino a Tel Aviv intentó estrellar su avión con 150 pasajeros

en.title: Pilot of Dubai flight bound for Tel Aviv attempted to crash plane with 150 passengers
en.summary: A crew member and passenger subdued an attacker who tried to stab the pilot and crash the aircraft, preventing a disaster.

stories.title: La economía da un respiro a Trump a un mes de las elecciones 'midterms'

en.title: The economy gives Trump a breather a month before the midterm elections
en.summary: The U.S. revised second-quarter GDP growth upward to 2.2% from 1.5%, inflation came in at 3.4% below expectations, and the private sector added 90,000 jobs.
